title: Indian monsoon and seasons
quote: Monsoon: seasonal winds that reverse direction with the season - sea to land in summer, land to sea in winter

boxes.title: Theories of the monsoon
head: Theory
Core idea
rows: Land heats faster → summer low over land draws moist sea winds
ITCZ over Ganga plain = ==**monsoon trough**==; SE trades cross equator as SW winds
==**STJ** north of Himalayas → onset==; back south → withdrawal; **TEJ** with SW monsoon
Heat island → low pressure, stronger TEJ
**El Nino weakens**; La Nina aids; positive IOD offsets El Nino

boxes.title: Key terms
items: **Breaks**: trough shifts to foothills → plains dry

items.what: Retreat from NW; "**October heat**"; Bay cyclones
